prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one production game sprite atlas for an original high quality 2D hard-SF action game, LUMEN WING. Generate ONE 2048x1024 transparent PNG, laid out as EXACTLY FOUR equal columns and TWO equal rows, eight isolated mechanical vehicles, one per cell, centered in each cell with 12 percent clear margin. NO labels, letters, captions, grid lines, backgrounds, floor, shadows or effects outside the machine. Truly transparent alpha background.
Art: richly detailed hand-painted high-end Japanese arcade mecha concept render, crisp readable mechanical forms, dimensional faceted metal, ceramic armor, tiny panel seams, hydraulics, layered armor, railguns and engine nozzles. Clearly manufactured spacecraft / war machines, NOT insects, animals or organisms. Slight overhead orthographic game camera, 25 degrees above the horizontal plane, zero perspective exaggeration. Each whole machine must fit its own cell. Keep distinct silhouettes and strong edge highlights for readability on dark blue space. No big glow, no engine trails; animate those separately in game.
TOP ROW left to right:
1) Player LANCER, faces RIGHT: elegant ivory and vermilion armored interceptor with narrow long nose, a teal armored canopy, TWO long forward railgun barrels extending to the right from attached shoulder pods, compact attached rear engine modules, gold small structural accents. Aggressive purposeful premium mecha fighter, angular retractable hardpoints and exposed graphite joints, not a plain triangle.
2) Player BASTION, faces RIGHT: heavy cobalt-blue and titanium siege craft, broad shoulder armor, FOUR short attached engine pods, stocky shield plates and big paired cannons, cyan lens, industrial but elegant, distinct from Lancer.
3) Player WRAITH, faces RIGHT: slim graphite-black and jade sniper craft, long single spinal cannon and twin narrow fins, thin mint luminous strips, sophisticated stealth armor.
4) Enemy SCOUT, faces LEFT: compact crimson/graphite angular drone with attached ion engine, slit sensors and armored face, no eyes, no wings.
BOTTOM ROW left to right:
5) Enemy INTERCEPTOR, faces LEFT: orange-red scythe-nosed attack drone with paired attached missile pods, angular hard armor.
6) Enemy TURRET, faces LEFT: bronze/black floating artillery platform with four short outriggers and a central twin rotary cannon, square machined plates.
7) Enemy CARRIER, faces LEFT: dark burgundy/steel broad heavily armored gunship with multiple missile bays, four rear engine nozzles and two chunky forward guns, imposing distinct silhouette.
8) Boss ECLIPSE, faces LEFT: massive ivory, charcoal and antique-gold mechanical flying dreadnought, layered armored command hull, turbine modules, staggered heavy cannon turrets, two attached railgun side nacelles, reactor grills and narrow red sensor windows, intricate ship silhouette. No simple circular target or icon; an actual formidable mechanical battleship.
All 8: same rendering style and camera, dense precise readable materials, sharp contrast, no text whatsoever. Original design.
